title: Zatanna — Turn software workflows into reliable APIs for AI agents |
text:
Zatanna maps human-only software workflows and exposes them as reliable APIs your AI agents and internal tools can call in production. No browser automation scripts to maintain.

UIs are for humans, not agents
APIs for
any EHR
Any portal becomes a fast, stable API your agents call in production — even the ones with no public API. No browser bots to babysit.

What we do
The real API was always there. We just expose it.
Capture the real API
We observe the actual network traffic behind your portal workflows and reconstruct the exact request flow — auth, sessions, sequencing, everything.
One stable endpoint
Your agents call a single, clean API. We manage auth, retries, anti-bot detection, and session handling underneath.
Milliseconds, not seconds
Direct API calls instead of browser automation. No UI dependencies, no fragile selectors, no headless Chrome overhead.

FAQ
Common questions
How is this different from browser automation or computer use?+
Browser automation renders full pages and clicks through UIs — it breaks when anything changes, is slow, and fails at scale. Zatanna works at the network layer. We reverse-engineer the underlying API calls behind any portal and deploy them as direct endpoints. That means milliseconds instead of seconds, structured data instead of scraped HTML, and integrations that don't break when a button moves.
What does Zatanna do?+
Zatanna reverse-engineers the network traffic behind any web portal and turns it into a stable, callable API. Walk through a workflow once — we capture the underlying request behavior and deploy it as an endpoint your agents can call in production.
Can Zatanna handle MFA and login flows?+
Yes. We handle stateful auth, MFA, cookie management, and session refresh automatically. Your agents call the API endpoint — we manage everything below the authentication layer.
What if the portal changes?+
We work at the API layer, so frontend changes like UI redesigns or layout updates rarely affect your integrations. When backend behavior does change, our observability layer detects it and we repair the integration automatically.
How long does it take to get started?+
Book a 30-minute workflow review. We walk the workflow once, reconstruct the request flow, and deploy an endpoint. Most integrations are live within days.
